map.→ 打开装修造价估算器工具: -> Open the renovation cost estimator tool
map.为什么总超预算？: Why do I always go over budget?
map.半包和全包怎么选？: How do I choose between partial and full fit-out?
map.半包省主材钱但要自己盯，全包省心但主材受限；本工具只算量，模式按你时间精力定。: Partial fit-out saves on main materials but you have to supervise; full fit-out is easier but restricts the main materials. This tool only computes quantities; pick the mode based on your time and energy.
map.对比全包与半包总价，结合自己买主材的能力做模式选择。: Compare the total price of full and partial fit-out and combine it with your own ability to source main materials to pick a mode.
map.拆分水电、泥木、油漆、主材各项占比，找出花费大头重点控价。: Break down plumbing, masonry and carpentry, painting and main materials to find where the money goes and focus cost control there.
map.按『每㎡ 单价×面积』粗估硬装总价，再按简装/中装/精装三档调系数，定预算上限。: Estimate the total hard fit-out cost roughly as "unit price per m² x area", then adjust by a coefficient for basic, mid-range or premium finishes to set the budget ceiling.
map.每㎡单价怎么取？: How do I get the unit price per m²?
map.漏项（拆改、垃圾清运、美缝）、主材升级与增项是主因；本工具给基线，建议预留 10: Missing items (demolition changes, waste removal, caulking), main-material upgrades and extra charges are the main causes; this tool gives a baseline, so reserve a 10%-15% contingency.
map.装修造价估算器，按装修档次、分部分项工程与材料人工拆分并考虑城市系数，辅助预算编: The renovation cost estimator splits the cost by finish level, trade and material/labour and applies a city coefficient, which helps with budget preparation.
map.随城市、年份与材料波动；简装 600–900、中装 1000–1500、精装 1: Fluctuates with city, year and materials; 600-900 CNY/m² for basic, 1000-1500 for mid-range and 1800+ for premium are common ranges, subject to local prices.
